items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart suffered sprained MCL on MNF, ruled out, X-rays negative, MRI pending; expected to miss some time but positive overall. Winston replaced him.
items.why: Left knee injury on hit; initial exams sprained MCL.
items.implication: Giants QB situation unstable short-term; Winston or backup next.
items.opportunity: Potential for more designed runs or different play-calling; Skattebo/RB usage already strong.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Confirmed by Schefter as well.
items.why: Hip injury; true GTD that went inactive.
items.implication: Rams WR pivots needed; Adams/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Davante Adams and other Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL, likely miss a few weeks. Team signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: Sprained MCL while blocking vs Titans; did not return.
items.implication: Eagles TE void; Ertz elevation likely for Week 3+.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other Eagles pass-catchers short-term; Ertz stash/stream.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow; imaging/specialists consult. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (recurring issue); X-rays no fracture, more tests.
items.implication: Mariota starts Week 3; Daniels timeline TBD but history of multi-week.
items.opportunity: Commanders skill players face downgrade in efficiency/mobility.

items.text: Giants all 4 RBs active MNF but Tracy ST-only (1 snap). Cam Skattebo 34 snaps/16 opps, Singletary 15/4, Najee Harris 8/4.
items.why: Clear lead in snaps and opportunities despite Dart injury chaos.
items.implication: Skattebo emerging as primary Giant RB.
items.opportunity: High snap share even in loss; continue monitoring with Dart out.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel injury; hoping midseason return.
items.why: Aggravated heel; X-rays negative but multi-week rehab.
items.implication: Colts WR depth thinned; targets to Pittman/others if healthy, or Downs/Warren.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs or Michael Pittman (if back) or other Colts WRs/TE upgrade.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams hamstring injury; coach Ben Johnson says expectation he will likely miss some time, week-to-week. Same hamstring as prior college injury.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring pull; carted off, walking postgame with limp.
items.implication: Bears backup QB; offense downgrade especially mobility.
items.opportunity: Watch Bears WRs/RBs for volume changes under backup.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell relegated.
items.opportunity: High snap share, goal-line/third-down potential for Irving.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs speed with Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson less secure.
items.opportunity: Henderson routes/carries increase; committee but explosive upside.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring). Grab Jonah Coleman.
items.why: Optimism confirmed for McConkey; Harvey not expected and inactive.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Harvey handcuff/Coleman opportunity realized.
items.opportunity: Coleman as RB beneficiary in DEN backfield.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Prefer Parkinson flex pivot; then Malachi Fields or Konata Mumpford at WR.
items.why: Puka inactive opens speculative targets in Rams offense.
items.opportunity: Parkinson TE or Fields/Mumpford WR volume spikes.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.why: Extremely poor yards per route run early 2026.
items.opportunity: LAC other WRs (McConkey if healthy) preferred.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.why: Both TEs exited; Gadsden filled void with solid route share.
items.implication: Gadsden TE streamer/handcuff if Njoku/Kolar miss time.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading WRs in expected PPR. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early.
items.opportunity: Consistent high target share in PHI offense.
